display.purpose: Hero numeric figures only (reserve, monthly allocation, remaining-to-save, fund balance).

title.purpose: Card header bars (700, white), tab bar, fund name field.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, stat-tile captions.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: At-rest elevation for every card, stat-tile — the board's constant soft lift, not a hover-only effect.

shadows.name: shadow-modal
shadows.purpose: Modal dialog elevation, on top of the backdrop dim.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: 1px hover lift on buttons; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: chevron-rotate
motion.purpose: 180° rotation on a collapsible section's chevron when it opens.

components.name: Card with Board Header
components.description: Section container with a full-bleed colored header bar (the signature board move). Swap --card-accent for gold/sage/berry via the card-gold/card-sage/card-berry modifier classes.
components.html:
הוצאות לפי חודש

Card body content.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; --card-accent: #1d3f60; background: #fef9f7; border: 1px solid rgba(18,11,10,0.10); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,11,10,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(18,11,10,0.08); padding: 20px; } .ds-card-berry { --card-accent: #912061; } .ds-card-gold { --card-accent: #a06200; } .ds-card-sage { --card-accent: #196632; } .ds-card-header { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: var(--card-accent); margin: -20px -20px 16px -20px; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0; }

components.name: Collapsible Card (details/summary)
components.description: Progressive-disclosure variant of the board header: native <details>/<summary> with the same colored bar styling plus a rotating chevron. Open by default for content checked every time; closed by default for sections usually empty.
components.html:
מעשרות ▾

Card body content.
components.css: .ds-card > summary, details.ds-card > summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: var(--card-accent); margin: -20px -20px 16px -20px; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0; } details.ds-card > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } details.ds-card:not([open]) > summary { margin-bottom: -20px; border-radius: 15px; } .ds-chevron { transition: transform 0.15s ease-out; } details[open] .ds-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action (save, refresh). Chunkier radius and bold weight vs. the pre-board system.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1d3f60; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 20px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d3f60; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #524440; border: 1px solid #bdada9; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 20px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d3f60; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Hero-figure card: label + large tabular-nums value, colored by the surrounding card's board accent.
components.html:
הפרשה נדרשת לכל חודש
₪1,250
components.css: .ds-stat-tile { background: #fef9f7; border: 1px solid rgba(18,11,10,0.10); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,11,10,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(18,11,10,0.08); padding: 16px; min-width: 220px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #524440; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 1.6rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--card-accent, #1d3f60); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Solid-fill status chip (white text) — deliberately not a tinted pill, matching monday's solid status-cell look. Universal across all board colors.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-good { background: #036819; } .ds-badge-critical { background: #b00a1d; }

components.name: Segmented Pill Tabs
components.description: Filled segmented-pill tab bar; active tab is a solid Dusk Slate pill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #faf3f1; border: 1px solid rgba(18,11,10,0.10); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: #524440; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 18px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #1d3f60 10%, transparent); } .ds-tab-active { background: #1d3f60; color: #fff; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Bordered field, focus shifts border and background to the universal Dusk Slate accent (not the card's board color).
components.css: .ds-input { font: inherit; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #bdada9; border-radius: 10px; background: #fef9f7; color: #120b0a; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1d3f60; background: #faf3f1; outline: none; }

components.name: Delete Button (arm-then-confirm)
components.description: Text-only delete affordance; first click arms a warning label, second click within 3s commits.
components.css: .ds-delete-row { background: transparent; color: #6b5550; border: none; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-delete-row:hover { color: #b00a1d; } .ds-delete-row.confirming { color: #b00a1d; font-weight: 600; } .ds-delete-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d3f60; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Collapsible Month Row
components.description: Annual Budget's per-month toggle: a fixed-width name button (so the '+' add button lines up in a straight column regardless of Hebrew month-name length) plus an item count and rotating chevron. Empty months collapse by default.
components.css: .ds-month-toggle { background: transparent; color: #120b0a; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; padding: 0; border: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 120px; justify-content: flex-start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-month-toggle:hover { color: #1d3f60; } .ds-month-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-count { font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: FamilyBudget is one household's private ledger, not a fintech product for strangers — but the household explicitly asked for a bolder, livelier, more structured feel, naming monday.com's board view: chunky rounded shapes and a table/board structure with colored group headers (revision 2). Revision 3 added progressive disclosure after the household found the Annual Budget and Monthly Overview screens tedious and hard to hold in their head: the Monthly Summary moved to sit right after Income, and secondary detail sections became collapsible <details>, closed by default where usually empty. Revision 4 replaced the primary accent: the household found the terracotta orange too warm, so the primary/hero role moved to Dusk Slate, a deep muted slate-blue — not the bright corporate blue the very first revision moved away from. The underlying neutrals stayed warm (hue 35) on purpose, so the system reads as a warm structure carrying one cool, deep accent.
keyCharacteristics: Every card has a full-bleed colored header bar (white bold text on solid color), like a monday board group header
Four board colors, each with a fixed meaning: Dusk Slate (hero/default, deep muted slate-blue), Gold (money in), Sage (tithe & receivables), Berry (expenses & payables)
Warm hue-35 neutrals are decoupled from the primary accent's hue on purpose — an intentional warm-structure / cool-accent contrast
Chunkier, rounder shapes throughout: 10px button/input radius, 16px card radius, bold 600-weight labels
Soft card elevation (layered box-shadow) replaces the earlier flat-only system
Status badges are solid-fill chips (white text), not tinted pills
Tabs are a filled segmented-pill control, not an underline
Secondary detail sections are collapsible (native details/summary styled as the board header); the payoff card surfaces first
The Annual Budget's month rows collapse when empty, and their name buttons hold a fixed width so the add ('+') button aligns in a straight column
Tabular numerals everywhere money appears; RTL Hebrew native

rules.name: The Card-Owns-One-Color Rule
rules.body: Every card gets exactly one board color via --card-accent, applied to its header bar, tinted table rows, and hero figures. Never mixed within one card; the same card type always gets the same color.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Universal Rule
rules.body: Badge/status colors never change with the card's board color. Board color = wayfinding by section; status color = meaning. The two must never be confused.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries a small chroma tint toward a fixed warm hue (35), independent of the primary accent's own hue (now Dusk Slate's cool 250). Neutrals are never re-tinted to chase whatever the primary happens to be.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Any element displaying money or a count uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every text element maps to one of the five documented type sizes; no one-off inline font-size values.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: Every card-like surface casts a soft, tinted shadow at rest, never a hard or pure-black shadow, and never hover-only.

rules.name: Answer-Before-Detail Rule
rules.body: A screen's one summary/hero card stays a plain, always-visible .card near the top; supporting detail sections become collapsible <details>, closed by default when usually empty.

dos: Do keep the household scale: no multi-user chrome, no permissions UI, no team-oriented navigation — the board look is borrowed, not the team-collaboration function.
Do use tabular numerals for every monetary or count value.
Do give every card exactly one board color, assigned by money-direction meaning.
Do keep status chip colors identical everywhere regardless of the card's board color.
Do apply the soft card shadow to every card-like surface at rest.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 35, independent of the primary accent's hue.
Do put the answer before the detail: the summary card stays plain and visible; supporting sections collapse.
donts: Don't let a screen's total visible content grow unbounded just because the data model has room for it — collapse what's usually empty or already-reviewed.
Don't flatten cards back to borderless-and-shadowless; the shadow is load-bearing for the board feel now.
Don't make this feel like a corporate SaaS admin panel or an anxious finance app.
Don't add a fifth board color, or assign board colors arbitrarily instead of by money-direction meaning.
Don't let a board color leak into status-chip meaning.
Don't brighten or saturate Dusk Slate back toward a vivid sky/corporate blue — stay deep and low-chroma.
Don't re-tint the neutrals to follow the primary accent's hue.
Don't use border-left/border-right colored stripes as a card or row accent (the fund-card top-border is the one sanctioned exception).
Don't default to LTR layouts or English-first copy.
